Privacy policy

The current internal beta saves progress on your device. Here is what that includes, and what changes before live ads are added.

Last updated: November 15, 2026 · Scope: current internal beta and this website

On this page1. Scope & contact2. Local game data3. Test logs4. Advertising5. Support emails6. This website7. Delete your data8. Children9. Future updates

Internal beta policyThis policy describes the current pre-release implementation. Live Unity Ads and LevelPlay SDKs are not installed or connected. A build that adds an advertising or analytics service will need an updated policy before it is distributed.

1. Scope and contact

Edge Rush is a game by Gizmobyte, developed by Thingamajig in Malaysia. This policy covers the current internal beta and the static developer website.

For privacy questions or a request concerning a support message, email wkeongg@gmail.com. We have not implemented a game account, cloud save service, online leaderboard, or developer-operated analytics backend in this beta.

2. Data saved on your device

The game stores local data so that your progress, rewards, and preferences can survive closing the app:

  • Best scores, distance, close-call and combo records, and run/session counts.
  • Coin balances, unlocked and selected car looks, daily rewards, missions, and tutorial progress.
  • Music, sound, vibration, and reduced-effects settings.
  • First/last launch and reward dates, and reward history used to prevent duplicate grants.

Reward history can include the reward source, amount, balance, time, and randomly generated run or reward identifiers. These identifiers relate to game actions; this beta does not use them to create an online player account.

Save files and a local settings backup are kept in the app's device storage. Our game code does not upload this save data to a developer server. Device or operating-system backup and restore features may handle app data separately under your device settings.

Local data remains until it is overwritten, you clear the app's storage, or it is removed with the app. This game does not provide cross-device recovery through a game account.

3. Gameplay and diagnostic test logs

The beta records gameplay and diagnostic events for testing, such as run results, tutorial steps, reward attempts, coin transactions, and ad-flow errors. The event list is kept in memory with a limited recent history, and events are also written to Unity's local diagnostic logs.

There is no external analytics service connected to this event logger. We do not automatically receive these logs through a game backend. If you choose to send a screenshot or log in a support email, we receive the information you send.

Logs may remain available to you or to diagnostic tools on your device. Their handling and retention can also depend on the operating system and testing environment. This policy does not claim that the Unity runtime, Android, your device manufacturer, or your app distributor never processes technical data.

4. Simulated reward ads in this beta

Current internal development builds use an in-game TEST AD simulation to exercise optional reward flows. That simulation does not fetch an ad from an advertising network. Live advertising is not connected, and the real Unity Ads and LevelPlay SDKs are not installed in the current project.

The game may record the simulated result locally to test rewards and avoid duplicate grants. These test screens are not evidence that paid advertising has been approved or enabled.

If a later build adds real advertising, we will first update this policy to identify the actual services, data they process, purposes, privacy choices, and relevant third-party policies. The description of the current simulation must not be treated as a statement that a future ad SDK collects no data.

5. Support emails you send

If you email us, we receive your email address, your message, and any attachments or other information you choose to include. We use this information to respond, investigate problems, and manage the support conversation.

The support address uses Gmail, so your email is also processed by email service providers under their own terms and privacy policies. Please do not send passwords, banking details, identity documents, or other unnecessary sensitive information.

We keep support correspondence for as long as reasonably needed to handle the request and relevant follow-up. You can ask us to delete a support conversation; we will explain if any record must be retained for a legal or security reason. We do not sell game save data or support correspondence.

6. Visiting this website

This static website does not add analytics scripts, advertising tags, tracking cookies, a contact form, remote fonts, or embedded media. It does not use browser storage to create a visitor profile. Its email links open your chosen email app.

The service hosting a website receives ordinary web requests to deliver and secure its pages. If you visit this site on GitHub Pages, GitHub logs and stores visitors' IP addresses for security, whether or not they are signed in. See GitHub Pages data collection and the GitHub Privacy Statement.

Following an external link takes you to a separate service whose own privacy policy applies. This policy covers our site, rather than the independent operation of Android, TapTap, GitHub, or email providers.

7. Delete or reset your data

To delete the game's local progress on Android:

  1. Close Edge Rush and open your device's Settings.
  2. Open Apps → Edge Rush → Storage (or Storage & cache).
  3. Choose Clear storage or Clear all data, then confirm.

This resets local scores, coins, car unlocks, rewards, and settings. Clear cache alone does not reset your saved progress. Menu names vary by device; Android's storage help explains the distinction.

Uninstalling may remove the local data too, but an operating-system backup can restore app data when you reinstall. Manage any device or cloud backup separately using your provider's settings if you do not want that data restored. There is no in-game account or developer cloud save to delete. We cannot remotely recover or erase files on your device.

To request deletion of information you sent by email, contact wkeongg@gmail.com from the relevant address and identify the conversation. Do not attach identity documents unless a specific need is explained.

8. Children

Edge Rush is being developed for a general audience and is not directed to children. The current internal test is intended for adult testers. We do not ask players to enter their name, age, or contact information in the game.

If you believe a child has sent us personal information through support email, contact us so we can review the message and address its deletion.

9. Future updates

We will revise this page when the game's data practices or the website's services change, and show the updated date here. Before a release adds real ads, external analytics, accounts, or other online services, its policy and any required notices or consent controls must reflect the implementation of that release.

Questions about this beta? Contact support.
